name: Mockery
body:
Mockery (Ex)
Source Spymaster's Handbook pg. 27
The vigilante gains AntagonizeUM as a bonus feat. He can target a creature with the Intimidate version of Antagonize twice each day, rather than just once. At 12th level, the effects of the Intimidate version of Antagonize last a number of rounds equal to the vigilante’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
